absent: Capability detection for ITS presence and direct SGI support and host SGI capability beyond observed boolean predicates.
Propagation mechanics for virtual SGI reconfiguration and GICv4 reload broadcast and virtual CPU wake beyond observed call sites.
Lifetime and lookup rules for interrupt descriptors and virtual CPU resolution from affinity beyond observed acquire and release pairing.
Queueing and physical active handling for pending latches and enable and ITS invalidate operations beyond observed invocations.
Memory layout of distributor and CPU and interrupt and region and register descriptor structures beyond observed field uses.
Byte extraction and partial register merge and address to identifier translation helpers beyond observed call sites.
Continuation of redistributor SGI base register table after the truncated region and full access permission matrix.
Architectural numeric values and bit positions for control and type and identity constants beyond observed functional roles.

findings.text: Distributor misc read entry handles guest reads for a small group of global control and type and capability and identity registers selected by low address bits, returning zero for other offsets in its window. Control reflects current enabled state plus fixed architecture bits plus hardware SGI request state, type derives total interrupt count from configured shared count plus private count with identifier width and LPIS indication depending on ITS presence, capability advertises direct SGI support only when available, and identity composes product plus revision plus implementer information.

Distributor control write implements an enable lifecycle guarded by the per virtual machine configuration mutex. It updates the enabled flag from the guest value, suppresses the hardware SGI request when direct SGIs are unsupported, preserves the prior hardware SGI request when the distributor stays enabled across the write, reconfigures virtual SGIs on request edges, broadcasts a GICv4 reload to all CPUs when direct SGIs exist and enable toggles and otherwise wakes virtual CPUs on a fresh enable, while writes to type and capability and identity offsets are ignored.

Privileged userspace path for the same misc window enforces validation beyond the guest path. Capability writes succeed immediately when matching the current value and otherwise are rejected after initialization or when changing bits beyond the direct SGI capability or when host support is absent, identity writes are rejected unless only revision bits change to one of two supported revision values, control writes apply enable and hardware SGI request directly with suppression when direct SGIs are unsupported, and all other offsets fall back to normal guest handling.

Guest writes to distributor control hold the per virtual machine configuration mutex across the full read modify decision for enabled state and hardware SGI request state including the choice between reload broadcast and virtual CPU wake, preventing races with concurrent configuration changes.

Affinity routing registers provide per interrupt routing indexed by interrupt identifier derived from address. Reads return byte slices of stored affinity for the lower word only with the upper word always zero, while writes ignore the upper word entirely and for the lower word retain only low affinity levels and resolve the destination virtual CPU from the sanitized value while holding the interrupt lock.

Mutations of per interrupt routing and pending latch state acquire the per interrupt raw spinlock with interrupt state saved, covering affinity plus target CPU update and pending latch plus physical active handling, with interrupt reference acquisition before the lock and release after unlock.

Redistributor control implements a lifecycle for message based interrupts that is active only when an ITS is present. From disabled it can move to enabled through a single atomic transition that triggers enable processing, and from enabled it moves through a transient busy indication while flushing pending state and invalidating ITS caches before reaching disabled, ignoring redundant or concurrent requests, with reads adding fixed capability bits on newer implementation revisions.

A redistributor reports itself as last only when its index reaches the end of its region and no successor region starts exactly at its end with allocated entries. Its type value combines low affinity plus virtual CPU identifier plus a message interrupt capability bit when an ITS exists plus the last indication, with byte extraction supporting partial reads.

Identity and discovery registers expose fixed values. One redistributor identity value combines a virtual product code shifted to the high byte with an ARM implementer code in the low bits, and one discovery offset for GICv3 compliance reports decimal fifty nine while all other discovery offsets in the window report zero.

Pending set and clear handling iterates over set bits in the access value to address individual interrupts starting from an identifier derived from address. Guest accesses to software generated interrupt bits in a version two model are ignored, version two source tracking records the requesting CPU on set and clears all sources on userspace clear, hardware backed software interrupts delegate pending changes to the host controller, and other hardware interrupts adjust physical pending and physical active so that a paired set followed by clear from the guest does not mask the physical line, with userspace replacement expressed as set plus complementary clear.

Attempts to change host side pending state for hardware backed software interrupts can fail, with failures reported through a rate limited warning that carries the host interrupt number while emulation continues without retry or propagation to the guest.

Memory attribute handling for message interrupt tables downgrades outer shareability to inner shareability, maps non cacheable inner variants to write back cacheable, preserves only two outer cacheability encodings and maps all others to match inner, and forces defined reserved bit ranges for property and pending base registers to zero.

Property and pending base registers share a gated update lifecycle with a busy indication for invalidations. Reads return byte slices with one pending zero on transmit flag hidden, writes are silently dropped once message interrupts are enabled and otherwise merge partial updates with sanitization under a sixty four bit compare exchange retry loop, and invalidate commands for one or all message interrupts are ignored for upper half accesses or when disabled or for identifiers below the message range, while valid commands raise a per CPU busy count visible through a sync register for the duration of the work.

Memory mapped tables bind distributor and redistributor offsets to handler pairs with lengths and access widths. Per interrupt groups are split into a private window that always reads zero and ignores writes and a shared window with real handlers for group and enable and pending and active and priority and configuration and routing, while global control and status and identity and base address and invalidate and sync registers each have dedicated handlers.

Observed register windows advertise fixed sizes and widths. Examples include a sixteen byte active priority window with word access, four byte control and status and identity windows with word access, eight byte type and base and invalidate windows with double word and word access, and forty eight byte discovery windows with word access, with per interrupt strides of one and two and eight and sixty four bits across shared groups.
Three sanitization helpers for shareability and inner cacheability and outer cacheability are defined without internal linkage and are visible for reuse in base register handling.
Two userspace helpers for setting and clearing pending state are defined without internal linkage and return a status code after applying the corresponding latch update.
A helper for driving host side physical pending state from a virtual interrupt descriptor is defined without internal linkage for use by pending handling.

Redistributor control and base and sync state use lock free atomics instead of sleeping locks. Enable transitions rely on acquire compare exchange with release store, base registers use single read plus sixty four bit compare exchange retries, and sync busy is a counted value with ordering barriers around increment and decrement.

Storing base addresses after message interrupts are enabled is treated as architecturally undefined and the write is silently discarded, making programming order before enable load bearing for correctness.
